hints.tr:

import numpy as np


def replace_first(names, new):
    arr = np.array(names, dtype=object)
    arr[0] = new

print(replace_first(["ab", "cde"], "hello"))

hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import numpy as np


def replace_first(names, new):
    arr = np.array(names, dtype=object)
    arr[0] = new
    return arr.tolist()

print(replace_first(["ab", "cde"], "hello"))
```
